title: ECR International Recalls Gas-Fired Hot Water Residential Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled residential boilers can be missing the flue inspection cover plate, posing a risk of exposure to combustion flue gasses and a carbon monoxide poisoning hazard. Units: About 1,745.

title: Electrolux Group Recalls Frigidaire Gas Laundry Centers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The felt seal on the dryer drum can be folded inward which can lead to lint accumulation, creating a fire hazard. Units: About 13,600.

title: Yamaha Personal Transportation Vehicles Recalled Due to Crash and Injury Hazards; Manufactured by Yamaha Motor Powered Products (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled personal transportation vehicles can accelerate unexpectedly, posing crash and injury hazards to consumers. Units: About 370.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Residential 300 Series Snow Blowers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled 300 series snow blowers can unexpectedly go into drive mode and collide with a consumer, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,700 (In addition, about 4,400 were sold in Canada).

title: VRURC Portable Chargers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by VRURC; Caught Fire on Commercial Flight
summary: The recalled portable chargers can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 190,000.

title: woom Bikes USA Recalls woom ORIGINAL Kids' Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stem and handlebar on the bikes can detach and cause riders to lose control, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 84,000 (In addition, 533 were sold in Canada).

title: Yamaha Golf Car Company Recalls Model Year 2023 Golf Cars, Personal Transportation Vehicles And Umax Due to Crash and Injury Hazards and Risk of Death (Recall Alert)
summary: The accelerator spring can become dislodged, allowing the accelerator pedal not to return to the resting position, posing crash and injury or death hazards. Units: About 11,000 (In addition, about 2,200 were sold in Canada).

title: GAF Energy Recalls Timberline Solar Energy Shingles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The electrical components in the solar energy shingles can malfunction, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,100.

title: Soft Play Recalls Sky Wheels Due to Fall Hazard and Risk of Injury to Children (Recall Alert)
summary: The Sky Wheels can become detached from the overhead rail on the play set, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury to children. Units: About 3,500.

title: True Fitness Recalls Showrunner II Consoles Sold with Fitness Equipment Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An exposed area of the wireless charging board can come in contact with other internal wiring, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 600.

title: Pottery Barn Kids Recalls Penny Convertible Cribs Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The cribs' end panel can become loose exposing sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 310.

title: Salewa USA Recalls Wild Country Superlight Rocks Cable Wire Chocks Used for Climbing Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When exposed to seaside conditions, corrosion can occur and weaken the cable chocks and they can break, posing a fall hazard to climbers. Units: About 3,550 (In addition, about 225 were sold in Canada).

title: Soojimus Recalls CUPKIN Stainless Steel Children's Cups Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban (Recall Alert)
summary: The stainless-steel cups contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 346,000.
